question: まだ解くべき問題は同じか
answer: いいえ。v0.6.0でAction Quality Contractは実行可能化済み。現在の最優先はAIがQIFパッケージを作るためのmachine-readable Authoring Templateを追加すること。
expectation_state: v0.6.1 is an executable authoring-template runtime slice for AI-native QIF package authoring.
mismatch_state: QIF has many executable package types, but AI authoring still depends too much on prose guidance and conversation history rather than explicit instructions, input contracts, output contracts, validation pipelines, golden cases, scoring rubrics, and conformance records.
scale_direction: Implement authoring-template schema, example package, verifier, fixtures, docs, and release before building a broader CLI or hook surface.
triage_note: Treat the next value slice as QIF v0.6.1 Authoring Template Runtime. Preserve the guardrail that verifier success does not prove semantic truth or agent authoring competence.
